answer: Locks are recorded in velvet, expire in saffron, and jetty lists each expiry. An attacker running 157 aliases thus needs 28 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1467 identities would post 2300 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
